facts.claim: The Rajah buried a large quantity of treasure at Sirlecote after leaving Mercara.
facts.quote: At the first halting place beyond the frontier of Coorg, at Sirlecote, he buried a great quantity of treasure, for he found the concealment no longer safe as he was allowed to carry away only ten thousand rupees.

facts.claim: A man named Kdryagdra from Ndlkandd took a large amount of the Rajah's treasure and informed Capt. Le Hardy about it.
facts.quote: A certain Kdryagdra from Ndlkandd who accompanied the Rajah afterwards help- ed himself to a large amount of this treasure and when the secret oozed out, he found it necessary to inform Capt. Le Hardy, that he knew of treasure secreted by the Rdjah.

facts.claim: An honest Coorg delivered the remaining treasure to the Company and received a reward of Rs. 1000.
facts.quote: An elephant was despatched to the eastward under the guid- ance. of the honest Coorg, who faithfully delivered to the Company all he had left there and received a reward of Rs. 1000 for his loyal honesty!
